# brig sandbox clean

Delete the expired sandboxes that brig sandbox run left

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox clean [VM] --runs
```

## Description

With --runs, delete the sandboxes of a VM that [`brig sandbox run`](brig-sandbox-run.md) kept, or left
behind when it was killed, once their brig.dev/expires label has passed. A
run's sandbox expires a day after the run started, or with --timeout, an
hour past the timeout. -w deletes only those of that workspace;
BRIG\_WORKSPACE does not narrow it.

## Examples

```sh
brig sandbox clean dev --runs
brig sandbox clean --runs -o json
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-o, --output format` | output format: table or json (default `table`) |
| `--runs` | delete the expired sandboxes of brig sandbox run |
| `-w, --workspace string` | delete only the sandboxes of this workspace |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
